D/ IMP C DIOCLETIANVS P F A (M is in a ; R/ GENIO POPVLI ROMANI

A Roman copper alloy coin, a contemporary copy of a follis of Diocletian dated AD 296-303 (c.f. RIC VI, p. 182, no. 172a). Reverse: GENIO POPVLI ROMANI. Mint: Trier. Obverse: Laureate and cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: IMP C DIOCLETIANVS P F A (M is in a crude style and there is no AVG). Reverse: Genius standing left, modius on head, naked but for chlamys over left shoulder, right…
